_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: S&P Global 'is a leading provider of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets, asset levels and flows into investment products, changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets, and volatility in the commodities markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.91x; +44% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.56; conservative 2yr -20%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.2%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.7%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.0%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SPGI (retrospective, 2019-05-10) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.91x (68.7% downside to Bear $67 / +23.6% upside to Bull $265) | Adj composite 1.45 vs market 3.01: gap -1.56 [OVERVALUED] | +44% above the EPP floor $149 (18x FY19E $8.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: -19.7% total (-9.8%/yr) | At 25.9x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $283 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue -0.5% in Q1 2019, forward revenues +0.3% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2019 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
